Stellenangebot: Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) Für unser Unternehmen, einen führenden SaaS-Enablement-Dienstleister , suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n Senior Account Executive – Enterprise Industrial Software (m/w/d) .

SingularitySales ist bekannt für erstklassige Leistungen im Bereich Go-to-Market und der Skalierung innovativer Softwarelösungen. Wir legen besonderen Wert auf eine moderne Unternehmenskultur, die Offenheit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung fördert.

Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du eine zentrale Säule unseres Vertriebsteams im Bereich Enterprise Industrial Software und spielst eine entscheidende Rolle beim Aufbau und Closing strategischer Deals mit Großkunden aus dem Fertigungsumfeld.

Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Kundenbedarfe präzise zu analysieren, maßgeschneiderte Softwarelösungen zu präsentieren und Entscheidungsträger bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss zu begleiten. Dabei baust du langfristige Partnerschaften auf und positionierst das Produkt-Portfolio strategisch in deinem Marktbereich.

Wenn du dich durch exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten, starkes Business-Verständnis im industriellen Umfeld und eine nachweisbare Erfolgsbilanz im Closing komplexer Enterprise-Deals auszeichnest, freuen wir uns auf deine Unterstützung.

Dich erwartet eine anspruchsvolle Rolle mit hoher Verantwortung – und die Möglichkeit, deine Karriere auf das nächste Level zu bringen, eingebettet in ein dynamisches Umfeld, das lebenslanges Lernen, Entwicklung und gemeinsame Erfolge fördert.

Sei Teil eines Teams, das mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen vorantreibt, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut und ambitionierte Wachstumsziele realisiert. Requirements Deine Mission: Als Senior Account Executive (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Outsourcing-Teams für einen führenden Anbieter industrieller Softwarelösungen.

Deine Mission: den kompletten Sales-Cycle eigenverantwortlich zu steuern – von der präzisen Analyse der Kundenbedarfe über die Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Enterprise-Lösungen bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

Dabei agierst du als vertrauensvoller Partner im Namen unseres Kunden, baust langfristige Beziehungen mit Entscheidungsträgern auf und positionierst das Portfolio strategisch im Markt. Mit deinem Beitrag stellst du sicher, dass Wachstum messbar wird und die Sales-Exzellenz unseres Kunden nachhaltig gestärkt wird.

Deine Aufgaben: Closing & Deal Ownership: Verantwortung für den gesamten Abschlussprozess – vom ersten Meeting (ausführliche Discovery und Business Case) bis hin zur erfolgreichen Vertragsunterzeichnung.

Kundenberatung: Analyse komplexer Anforderungen aus dem Manufacturing- und Industrieumfeld, Präsentation maßgeschneiderter Softwarelösungen und Positionierung des Produktportfolios als strategischer Mehrwert.

Beziehungsmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Partnerschaften mit Entscheidern und Key Accounts in Fertigungsunternehmen, um nachhaltiges Wachstum zu sichern. Vertriebsstrategie: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Go-to-Market-Ansätzen im Namen des Kunden, mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Impact im industriellen Enterprise-Umfeld.

CRM- & Pipeline-Management: Sicherstellen einer präzisen Forecasting- und Opportunity-Steuerung im CRM-System, um volle Transparenz über den Sales-Funnel zu gewährleisten. Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse: Beobachtung von Trends im Bereich Industrial Software & Manufacturing, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und Kunden proaktiv zu beraten.

Reporting & KPI-Steuerung: Erstellung von regelmäßigen Berichten zu Sales-Performance, Conversion Rates und Forecasts für Management und Stakeholder. Dein Profil: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Solution-Selling, idealerweise im Bereich Enterprise Software, Industrial Software oder SaaS im Fertigungsumfeld.

Nachweisbare Erfolge im Closing komplexer Deals und in der Erreichung oder Übertreffung ambitionierter Vertriebsziele. Tiefes Verständnis für industrielle Geschäftsmodelle sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Softwarelösungen in klaren Business-Value zu übersetzen.

Starke kommunikative und überzeugende Fähigkeiten auf C-Level – schriftlich, telefonisch und in Präsentationen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Forecasting und Opportunity-Management. Strategisches Mindset kombiniert mit Hands-on-Mentalität, um Kunden durch den gesamten Sales Cycle zu führen.

Hohe Eigenmotivation, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld erfolgreich zu agieren. Wir bieten: 100% Remote – arbeite von wo du willst, in einem globalen Team mit echtem Impact. Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket inklusive leistungsbezogener Boni.

Direkter Zugang zu Entscheidern – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen. Ein Umfeld, das High Performer fordert und fördert – ohne Corporate-Bremsen. Ein engagiertes und leidenschaftliches Team, das Werte wie Innovation, Integrität und Teamarbeit hochhält.

Highlights Enterprise-Deals im industriellen Softwareumfeld – von der Pipeline bis zum Abschluss, 100% remote, 100% ownership. 🚀 Originally posted on Himalayas

Position Summary Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology.

They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges. The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships.

They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations. Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions. Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.

Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services. Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.

Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment. Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities. Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs. Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.

Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs. Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications. Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark ’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams. Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.

Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation. Qualifications Required 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency. Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.

Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time. Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting. Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally. Preferred Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.

Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools. What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness.

They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands.

This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution. EEO Statement Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Agicap
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!

A Junior Account Manager owns and manages a smaller book of less strategic, lower-complexity client accounts, acting as the primary point of contact for that assigned group while developing the skills required to manage the full account lifecycle.

This role is structured as roughly half hands-on account ownership and half dedicated learning and skill-building, in contrast to the Account Manager role, which owns a full book of business and is fully invested in that responsibility.

This role is designed for someone early in their career who is building hands-on experience in account growth, contract proposals, and negotiations, while developing technical expertise across the Zoomph platform and within the sports sponsorship industry, with the goal of growing into a full Account Manager position.

The Junior Account Manager plays an active role in ensuring client satisfaction, retention, and growth at Zoomph .

This individual is responsible for a smaller, less strategic book of accounts, splitting their time evenly between managing those accounts and learning to identify and execute expansion opportunities, draft contract proposals, and engage in negotiations, with mentorship and guidance from senior Account Managers and the Director, Account Manager.

They are developing strong communication and problem-solving skills, building technical fluency in the platform and industry, and working collaboratively with internal teams to deliver tailored client solutions. Client Relationship Management
Own and manage a smaller book of less strategic, lower-complexity general client accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and building relationships that drive adoption, satisfaction, and renewals; this is expected to occupy roughly half of the role, with the remaining time dedicated to structured learning and skill development (versus the Account Manager role, which owns a full book of business as a fully invested, primary responsibility).
Build and nurture relationships with client stakeholders within their assigned book of accounts, with mentorship and guidance from senior Account Managers.
Provide day-to-day client support by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and delivering solutions that enhance client satisfaction and retention, escalating complex issues to senior Account Managers as needed.
Anticipate client needs and advocate for them within Zoomph , positioning the platform as a valuable partner in their success.
Assist in preparing client-facing materials, including proposals, reports, and presentations, to support client communication.
Customer Growth and Retention
Support onboarding sessions for general clients, helping ensure smooth implementation of the Zoomph platform.
Assist in monitoring client usage under the guidance of senior Account Managers to help identify risks and engagement opportunities.
Help clients understand basic platform capabilities and data insights to support their business goals.
Assist in compiling reports, performance metrics, and insights that demonstrate Zoomph 's impact on clients' business goals.
Help prepare for and coordinate regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
Collaborate with internal teams (Customer Success, Product, Marketing), under the direction of senior Account Managers, to support client needs.
Assist with coordination among internal stakeholders to support timely, high-quality delivery of client solutions.
Collaboration with Customer Success Specialists
Work closely with the Customer Success team to help address client support needs and support a seamless client experience.
Assist Customer Success Specialists with onboarding support, training, and basic issue resolution for general clients.
Communicate relevant client feedback and account updates to Customer Success and Account Management leadership.
HubSpot Management
Own the renewal process for their assigned book of business, ensuring timely renewals and addressing any risks of churn, with support from senior Account Managers on more complex situations.
Identify and present expansion opportunities, such as additional features, services, or product upgrades, to enhance client value within their assigned accounts.
Actively monitor account performance, identifying and mitigating risks to ensure client retention and growth.
Renewals and Upsells

Own the growth of an assigned book of business, learning to identify, pursue, and close expansion opportunities within existing client accounts.
Write and prepare contract proposals for renewals, upsells, and new opportunities, with review and coaching from senior Account Managers.
Participate in and progressively take the lead on client negotiations, developing skills in deal structuring, pricing, and closing.
Build technical expertise across the Zoomph platform, including its data, reporting, and analytics capabilities, to speak knowledgeably with clients and internal teams.
Develop subject-matter expertise in the sports sponsorship industry, including partnership valuation, sponsorship metrics, and industry trends, to strengthen client conversations and recommendations.

Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
0-2 years of experience in account management, customer success, sales, or a similar client-facing role; relevant internship or academic project experience will be considered.

Eagerness to own a book of business and develop skills in identifying and closing upsell or expansion opportunities and managing renewals.
Willingness to learn contract proposal writing and to participate in and eventually lead client negotiations.
Motivated to build technical expertise across the Zoomph platform and develop subject-matter knowledge of the sports sponsorship industry.
Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic environment with evolving client needs and priorities.
Interest in or prior exposure to industries like sports, media, or entertainment is a plus.
Developing ability to build and maintain client relationships, with a desire to grow into a trusted advisor role.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Basic analytical mindset with a willingness to learn to interpret data and track key metrics.
Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM tools preferred; willingness to learn required.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Proactive problem solver with a customer-first mindset.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams.

Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in the SaaS industry or with data-driven platforms, ideally in a B2B context.
Basic knowledge of social media analytics, digital marketing, or sponsorship valuation tools and metrics.
Prior exposure to contract writing, deal negotiation, or sales enablement.
Exposure to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) or client-facing performance reporting is a plus.

Our platform helps over 4 million customers discover top restaurants and access real-time deals that save them up to 50% off the bill. We empower more than 8,000 venues to fill empty tables, increase foot traffic, and maximise revenue.
#1 app in Food & Drink and awarded Australia's Fastest Growing Tech Company by the AFR in 2025. Now is an exciting time to join our team. Initially co-founded by Marco Pierre White and leaders in the food tech scene, we're now a 150+ person scaleup that's growing fast and making waves in the industry.

s.h: Why You'll Love Working With Us
s.t:
Uncapped commission with strong earning potential - top performers make $200k OTE
Leave your own mark in the Tasmania
Clear career progression as EatClub scales in the AU and internationally
Exposure to new market launches and international expansion

A Day-in-a-Life of our Business Development ManagerÂ
As a Business Development Manager at EatClub, you will spend most of your time out in the market, meeting venue owners, building relationships, and growing the platform one partnership at a time.
Your territory is yours to build. You'll be walking into restaurants, calling operators, and scheduling meetings with the venues you believe will thrive on the platform. Some days start with mapping the neighbourhoods you want to focus on, identifying the venues that fit the product best, and planning how you'll approach them.
Most of your day is spent face-to-face with restaurant owners and managers. You're introducing EatClub, explaining how the platform works, and helping operators see how it can drive more customers through their doors.

Conversations move quickly - some venues sign up after one conversation, others take a few follow-ups - but momentum matters and your pipeline moves fast. Average time from first walk-in to signed agreement is under two weeks. You are not waiting on approval chains - you close and move on to the next one.
Between meetings, you're updating your pipeline, following up with prospects, and preparing for the next round of conversations.
You'll also work closely with the broader EatClub team, sharing insights about the local hospitality market, feeding back what venue owners are saying, and helping refine how we approach new cities as we expand across the AU.
This role suits someone who thrives working independently, does not need a manager to tell them what to do next, and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing a number on a board they built themselves.

s.h: On any given week, you will be
s.t:
Prospecting new restaurant partners through walk-ins, cold calls, and scheduled meetings.
Meeting venue owners and operators face-to-face across Tasmania
Delivering clear, confident product pitches that show how EatClub helps venues drive revenue.
Building and managing a high-volume pipeline of opportunities in your territory.
Negotiating and closing commercial agreements with venue partners.
Onboarding newly signed venues and supporting them through their first campaigns.
Tracking pipeline activity and maintaining accurate CRM records.
Hitting 15+ outbound activities daily - calls, walk-ins, and booked meetings combined.
Knowing your numbers: conversion rate, daily activity volume, and weekly pipeline value.
Type of projects you'll be working on at EatClub...
Launching EatClub into new Tasmanian cities: building strong venue pipelines, identifying priority neighbourhoods, and helping establish EatClub's presence in new markets.
Refining the sales playbook: sharing feedback from venue owners to improve outreach messaging, objection handling, and sales conversations.
Supporting new city launches. As we continue to grow, you will have a chance to be part of the team that kicks off new cities.
You have....
A proven track record in a high-volume, target-driven role - and the numbers to back it up. Not roughly. Specifically.
Comfort with high outbound activity, including cold outreach and in-person conversations.
Experience managing a pipeline and progressing deals independently.
Confidence in presenting solutions and negotiating commercial agreements.
A background that has tested your resilience: high-rejection environments, door-to-door, car sales, sport or high-volume outbound all count.
The ability to tell us your KPI attainment, conversion rate, and average deal cycle without having to look it up.
It would be extra awesome if you also had...
Previously worked in hospitality, food tech, SaaS, or marketplace businesses.
A strong network within the hospitality industry.
Experience helping launch or grow new markets or territories.
You are...
Driven and persistent - you stay motivated even when deals take time or conversations don't immediately convert.
Competitive and performance-oriented - you enjoy working towards clear targets and seeing the results of your effort.
Curious and thoughtful - you ask good questions to understand how venues operate and what matters to them.
Disciplined in your approach - you manage your time, territory, and pipeline with structure.
Quick to learn and adapt - you take feedback onboard and apply it quickly.
Committed to building a career in sales within a high-growth business.
Able to flip between high-volume outbound activity and in-person closing in the same day - without losing energy.
Energised by building from scratch, not maintaining what already exists.
Someone whose first instinct when a deal stalls is to go back to basics - not to escalate.
Maybe this role is not for you if....
You prefer desk-based or fully remote work.

(NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. Our company values guide our daily actions:

Safe : We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.

Committed to Serve : We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.

Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.

Driven : We deliver results in the right way.

Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.
We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants.

These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services ’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth.

Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities.

And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions.

The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.

Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility.

These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity.

We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.

Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy.

Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year). RECENT RECOGNITION

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly.

With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto 's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
The mission -
Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isn't a traditional SDR role.
You'll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.
You'll partner closely with an Account Executive carrying a $400K–$600K quota, working on enterprise deals averaging $30K–$60K ACV. You won't just hand over leads—you'll stay close to the deals you create, gaining first-handff exposure to how complex enterprise sales are won.
If you're looking for a role that teaches you how to think like an enterprise seller and not just book meetings, this is where that journey begins.
Where you'll leave your mark?
Own a high-volume Launch portfolio — renewals, upsells, and day-to-day relationships across a large book of startup and early-stage SMB accounts, prioritising by risk and value rather than treating every account the same way.
Run the renewal pipeline end to end — track renewals well ahead of expiry, forecast accurately , and close on time; a slow renewal is the fastest way to lose a low-touch account.

Negotiate commercial terms with confidence — pricing, discounts, and contract length, knowing when to hold firm and when to flex, especially on multi-year commitments.
Spot and close expansion opportunities — accounts ready to add frameworks (SOC 2 to ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA) or upgrade plans, pitched naturally within renewal conversations.
Get ahead of payment and billing risk — step in early on failed payments or lapsed billing before it turns into churn, one of the biggest causes of loss in this segment.

Work the system, not just the relationship — use CRM workflows, templates, and playbooks to manage volume efficiently, keeping renewal stage, risk flags, and outcomes logged in real time.
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and the audit team to unblock renewals, resolve billing disputes, and report regularly on portfolio health .

s.h: The kind of builder we're looking for -
s.t:
2–4 years in account management, customer success, renewals, or sales, ideally in SaaS — experience in security, compliance, or GRC software is a plus, not a requirement.
A confident, direct negotiator — comfortable discussing price and terms without getting defensive or over-discounting.

Strong organisational discipline — able to juggle a large number of accounts at different stages without letting things slip, working off dashboards and structured playbooks rather than ad hoc outreach.
A clear, concise communicator , written and verbal — this is fast, high-volume outreach, not long relationship-building calls.

Analytical enough to read account data — usage, payment status, renewal date — and decide what to prioritise each day.

Resilient and proactive — comfortable with pushback, price objections, and the occasional lost account, and flags risk before it shows up in a report.

Curious about compliance and security — or willing to get up to speed quickly on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 to be a credible main point of contact for lean teams without their own compliance staff.

How we care for our Sprinters?

Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.

Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.

We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.

We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.

Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.

Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto , talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Business Development Managers (BDMs) play a critical role in creating early-stage pipeline and advancing opportunities within enterprise provider accounts. This role bridges marketing-generated demand (“MQL”) and sales-driven evaluations by owning the motions that move opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and later, as they ramp up, Discovery → Evaluation in partnership with AVPs.
The BDMs will engage in omnichannel lead generation—email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling—to activate cold or stalled accounts, warm target personas, and secure meaningful early conversations. They will partner closely with AVPs to tailor account-based programs for priority systems, execute targeted plays using solution-specific Sales Playbooks, and ensure exit criteria are met to progress opportunities.
This individual partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to gather discovery insights, build relationship maps, capture exit-criteria–aligned intel, and drive early traction that sets AVPs up for success.
This is a high-impact, visible role for someone who is persistent, operationally excellent, highly organized, and comfortable navigating complex provider organizations.

Opportunity Advancement (Primary Focus)
Own the early-stage advancement of opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and as proficiency grows, Discovery → Evaluation.
Execute solution-specific Sales Playbooks to ensure all exit criteria are met before handoff.
Capture and document discovery answers (via email, prep, or call notes) to support progression.
Execute warm handoffs of qualified opportunities to AVPs with complete and accurate context.
Omnichannel Outbound & Lead Generation
Run multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling to activate early interest and secure meetings.
Engage cold accounts or pre-qualified accounts to generate first conversations for AVPs from Ideal Customer Persona (ICP) accounts
Conduct inbound lead triage and fast follow-up for prospects engaging with marketing assets or events.
Call clinical and operational office lines or executive assistants to schedule meetings and coordinate access.
Account-Based Engagement & Territory Support
Partner with AVPs to tailor account-specific ABM plays using provided templates and messaging frameworks.
Customize persona-based outreach sequences and messaging for specific territories and strategic accounts.
Maintain and continuously refine Sales Navigator filters to ensure the right personas and accounts stay in focus.
Build and maintain relationship maps at the opportunity and account level to track influence, organizational structure, and decision pathways.
Ensure all relevant contacts are captured, enriched, and updated within Salesforce.
Manage account specific paperflite landing pages for prospect accounts
Discovery Support & Insight Capture
Participate in early discovery calls (typically led by the AVP) to gather essential account context, pain points, and opportunity signals.
Take clear, structured notes and capture the information required to satisfy discovery-stage exit criteria.
Conduct light pre-call research to support AVP preparation and call strategy.
Sales Enablement & Collateral Preparation
Create v1 slideware or call prep materials using approved templates and automation tools for Qualify and Discovery conversations.

Experience & Skills
2–5 years in business development, inside sales, account development, sales support, or SDR roles — preferably in B2B enterprise software, healthcare, or complex technical sales environments.
Demonstrated success securing meetings, activating dormant accounts, or advancing early-stage pipeline.
Proficiency with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and outbound sequencing/cadence tools.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable reaching out to new stakeholders and handling gatekeepers.
Strong organization and note-taking skills; able to manage multiple accounts and opportunities simultaneously.
High resilience, persistence, and comfort engaging in outbound motions.
Ability to understand complex healthcare operations concepts (training provided, but curiosity is required).

Account Manager «Business Software Lösungen» (a) in Zürich oder St. Gallen
Bist du motiviert, die Erfolgsgeschichte von AXEPT weiterzuschreiben und ein Teil davon zu werden? Die Optimierung und Digitalisierung von Geschäftsprozessen mithilfe von innovativen Business Software Lösungen faszinieren dich.

Du möchtest den Kunden und Interessenten die optimale Lösung mit dem grössten Nutzen anbieten und sie mit deiner Kommunikationsstärke professionell beraten.

Dabei ist dir das Zusammenspiel zwischen Verkauf, Customer Service und Kunden sehr wichtig und du legst Wert auf Qualität und die langfristige Pflege der Kundenbeziehungen. «Axept» the challenge als Account Manager «Business Software Lösungen».

In dieser herausfordernden Position bist du oft bei unseren Kunden in der Ostschweiz vor Ort. Deine Hauptaufgaben sind der Ausbau und die Betreuung von bestehenden Kundenkontakten sowie die Akquise neuer Kunden.
Mit deiner schnellen Auffassungsgabe nimmst du die Bedürfnisse vom Kunden gezielt auf und analysierst verschiedene Lösungsmöglichkeiten.
Unsere Business Softwarelösung Abacus präsentierst du mit deiner Kommunikationsstärke und deinem guten Auftreten. Weitere Lösungen von uns – unsere AX\-Branchenlösungen – erweitern unser Portfolio und machen auch dein Arbeitsgebiet spannend und abwechslungsreich.
Ausserdem im Aufgabenportfolio: Organisation, Führung und Teilnahme an internen und externen Veranstaltungen.

Du hast mindestens 3 – 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Accountmanagement, idealerweise aber nicht zwingend im Vertrieb von ICT oder Software\-Lösungen. Du hast Freude am aktiven und strategischen Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen und der Neukundenakquisition. Genial wäre, wenn du bereits über ein bestehendes Netzwerk zu Kunden in der Region Ostschweiz verfügst.
Du solltest auf das sein, was du verkaufst und den Kunden gut beraten können. Das Wichtigste ist, dass du den Kunden und sein Business verstehst, auf ihn eingehen und ihm gute Lösungen aufzeigen kannst. Deine kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit und dein unternehmerisches Handeln werden ergänzt durch deine selbstständige Arbeitsweise.
Weiter wünschen wir uns grosses Interesse an IT und eine Faszination für Digitalisierungsthemen und die damit verbundene Chance für die Optimierung von Prozessen.
Was wir uns in deinem Bildungsrucksack vorstellen? Gar nicht so einfach, viele Wege führen zu uns. Erfolgversprechend sind sicher eine kaufmännische\- oder technische Ausbildung ergänzt mit Berufserfahrung in der Kundenberatung und im Lösungsverkauf.
Wenn du mit Abacus schon einmal in Berührung gekommen bist, umso besser. Ist aber nicht Bedingung.
Deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen freuen sich auf Verstärkung von einer unkomplizierten Person, die gerne lacht, auch über sich selber.

s.h: Und das hast du dann davon
s.t:
Einen anspruchsvollen, aber superspannenden Job, in den wir dich vor Ort gut einarbeiten. Und wenn du sattelfest bist, gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
Es ist uns ein wenig peinlich, uns für den vermutlich besten Teamspirit weit und breit selber zu rühmen. Darum zitieren wir hier einfach ein fünf Sterne\-Feedback von Kununu: «Teamspirit wird geschrieben». Stimmt!
Von null auf hundert in 20… nein, nicht Sekunden, Jahren. Wir sind , aber gesund gewachsen und gut organisiert. Doch etwas ist noch wie in unseren Anfängen: Die Strukturen sind schlank und du findest die richtigen Ansprechpartner leicht.
In unserem Bereich gehören wir zu den grösseren Playern und sind bekannt für unsere hohe Qualität. Kein Wunder, werden wir immer wieder als herausragend guter Umsetzungspartner ausgezeichnet.
Einen guten Lohn, den du mit deiner Leistung mitbestimmen kannst. Krankentaggeld\- und Unfallversicherung? Übernehmen wir. Zusammen mit anderen Benefits macht das einmal ein paar Tausender im Jahr aus.
Wir hätten noch viel mehr zu erzählen. Was deinen Job bei uns sonst noch spannend macht zum Beispiel. Wer wir sind und wie wir so ticken. Deshalb zögere nicht und macht dir dein eigenes Bild.
Schon Feuer gefangen? Du willst lieber schon heute als morgen loslegen? Dann her mit deinem CV oder dem Link auf dein LinkedIn\-Profil. Das Motivationsschreiben kannst du dir sparen, wir sind auch da völlig unkompliziert.
Und das (a) im Stellentitel? Es ist unser Statement für Vielfalt. Wir stehen auf durchmischte Teams. Alter, Herkunft, Hautfarbe oder Geschlecht sind uns egal. Bei uns sind (a)lle willkommen, die uns mit ihrem Talent weiterbringen. jid2b1f1a6jm jit0519jm jiy26jm

NetBox Labs is seeking a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to play a key role in the growth and expansion of our partner business. You will report to the VP of Partnerships. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to execute: drive NetBox Labs revenue by making our partners a force multiplier for our sales team.

That means hunting for partner opportunities, owning a partner-sourced pipeline, and expanding and deepening our existing partner relationships. This requires you to enable partner sellers to find, position, and win with NetBox Labs across our critical VAR, SI, and Technology Partner channels, from large national VARs to strong regional players.

We are looking for a hungry, high-energy doer; the person who makes things happen. The right candidate is a proven self-starter with initiative and self-sufficiency: someone who builds their own plan, creates their own momentum, and delivers results without waiting for direction.
Two things make this seat distinctive. First, the motion: this is a scaling business with real deal flow, a very active, fast-moving environment closing dozens of deals every quarter. As our platform adds new features and capabilities, we are winning larger and more complex enterprise deals.

You need to keep pace with today’s velocity and bring the experience to help us win upmarket. Second, the team: our sales organization is early in its career and growing fast. We need a CAM whose experience raises the whole team's game; co-selling, coaching deal strategy, and sharing hard-won channel craft.

Everything at NetBox Labs is new, and it changes daily. This role rewards curiosity, adaptability, and the commitment to put in the time to master our platform, our open source community, and our market. Experience here is a foundation to build on — never a playbook to coast on.
In this role you will
Hunt for revenue: prospect relentlessly for new opportunities within and alongside our partners; work with partner sellers and our sales organization to uncover, register, and advance deals in their account bases, bringing the same drive to partner-sourced pipeline that a top seller brings to net-new logos.
Selectively expand the partner portfolio: we are always open to new partners, especially large ones, but our team is lean and we qualify rigorously. Evaluate inbound and prospective partners with discipline, and work with the partner team to onboard only those that meaningfully strengthen our coverage.
Map and develop relationships within the Partner Field and Field Technical organizations: relentlessly discover new contacts, turn them into Champions for NetBox Labs, and convert those relationships into sales opportunities.
Own the number: build, forecast, and be accountable for a robust pipeline of Partner Sourced sales opportunities, and co-sell alongside our Account Executives to move deals from registration to close — at the pace our deal flow demands.
Coach as you close: co-sell with our Account Executives, run deal reviews, and share your channel knowledge and deal instincts that only experience teaches.
Drive joint go-to-market execution: build partner business plans, launch sales campaigns and enablement with partners, and hold both sides accountable for pipeline commitments.
Facilitate the effective and efficient interaction of NetBox Labs field and field technical teams with their counterparts at our partner organizations. Develop and maintain executive relationships with assigned Partners.
Learn relentlessly: invest the time to master the NetBox Labs platform, our open source ecosystem, and the network automation market — and keep learning as the product, the motion, and the market change week to week.
Keep Partner and Partner Deal information accurate and up to date within our CRM system. Provide accurate and timely reporting on key partner indicators and metrics.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of channel sales experience, with a strong emphasis on managing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), SIs, Boutique consulting firms, and Technology partners in the B2B high-tech space (SaaS, networking, Infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.).
Proven success in growing and managing a portfolio of partners with a measurable revenue impact: you can point to the pipeline you sourced and deals you helped close.
A strong sales orientation and hunter mentality: hungry, energetic, and treats partner recruitment and pipeline generation the way a quota-carrying seller treats their number.
A demonstrated self-starter who shows initiative and self-sufficiency: you thrive with autonomy, create your own structure, and do not need hand-holding to deliver results.
Range across deal types: you thrive in a very active, fast-moving, deal-rich environment, and you have the skills and mindset for larger, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals as that mix grows.
A coach’s mindset: genuine enjoyment in collaborating with sellers; you measure your impact in the team’s numbers, not just your own.
Learning agility: you quickly master new products, ecosystems, and markets, and you are energized, not exhausted, by an environment where everything is new and changes daily.
Start-up attitude: Ability to prioritize and act on the most important activities while working as a team to respond. Collaboration/coordination with your peers is the key to success. We are extremely fast paced.
Embrace AI: Leveraging AI to accelerate partnerships and add efficiency to your activities will be key. AI allows us to move / respond quickly.
In-depth understanding of partner business models, and sales cycles for a wide variety of partners.
Experience with partner tools including PRM systems, CRM (Hubspot preferred), and deal registration platforms.
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to influence Partner executives, sales reps, and technical stakeholders.

Experience across the VAR landscape, including large national VARs, regional VARs, and SI/Consulting partners.
Technical background or experience in networking, enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, or security.
Startup experience at an organization experiencing hypergrowth.
Knowledge or background with partners in Networking, Network Engineering, and/or Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.
The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.h: In your first month, you will
s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
